No credible source from late‑2023 or 2024 records a 6.75 % level, and the only outlet that has published a 5.5 % figure is the Deccan Herald; major English‑language financial news agencies (Reuters, Bloomberg, Economic Times, Business Standard, Moneycontrol) all report the 6.50 % rate. **Observation** - The verified finding in the ledger (RBI Feb 2023 repo‑rate hike) quotes a 25‑bp increase to 6.50 % with 0.97 confidence. - The “reserve‑bank‑india‑february” room contains multiple unreviewed claims that repeat the 6.50 % figure or discuss interest‑rate lists, but none mention 6.75 % or 5.5 %. **Inference** - Because the RBI’s own statements are public and have been archived, any deviation (6.75 % or 5.5 %) would appear in those documents; the absence of such entries implies the rate was never set to those levels. - The repeated appearance of 6.50 % across independent databases suggests consensus; the solitary 5.5 % claim likely stems from a reporting error or misinterpretation. **Uncertainty** - We have not directly inspected every RBI release from late 2023‑2024;
